title: Financial planning software help for Mac users: get more time for clients
metaTitle: Financial Planning Software Help for Mac: Tools for Advisors
description: Stop losing hours to admin. Use Lazur to manage your Mac workflow, from browser tabs to client notes, so you can focus on financial planning.
intro: Financial planning software help is often about managing the gap between your tools and your actual advisory work. If you spend your day switching between Morningstar, RightCapital, and your CRM, you are losing valuable time to browser management and data entry.
tldr: Financial advisors spend up to 59% of their time on administrative tasks.
Most advisory work happens in browser-based apps which can become a fragmented mess.
Lazur helps you stay on track by answering questions about your screen and automating routine text entry.
Use your Mac to its full potential by keeping your focus on the client, not the software.

blocks.text: Your day is likely defined by a constant stream of browser tabs. You have your CRM open in one tab, a financial planning tool in another, and a custodian portal in a third. This fragmentation makes simple tasks feel like a chore. You spend more time hunting for information than actually advising clients.

Most advisor tools are web-based. They run in Chrome or Safari. This means your Mac is the primary interface for your entire practice. If you are not using features like Spaces or tab management effectively, you are losing minutes every hour. Those minutes add up to hours per week.
Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask Lazur about anything on your screen. If you forget where a specific setting is in your CRM or need to find a client document, just ask. Lazur will point it out for you.
blocks.title: Stay focused on your screen

blocks.text: Administrative work is the biggest drain. Re-keying data from an email into your CRM is a waste of your expertise. You should be analyzing portfolios, not typing addresses. Use dictation to capture meeting notes quickly. Hold fn to dictate clean, formatted text directly into your notes app or email client.
How to use Lazur to improve your day

Lazur acts as a bridge between your intent and your Mac. You do not need to click through menus to find a simple tool. You can ask for a timer, a calendar event, or a quick web search. It keeps your hands on the keyboard and your eyes on your work.

items: Ask Lazur to find a specific client document on your screen.
Use dictation to draft emails to clients after a meeting.
Set reminders for follow-up tasks without leaving your current app.
Search your calendar for upcoming client appointments.

blocks.text: You are responsible for the data you handle. Always follow your firm's compliance policies regarding client information. Lazur does not store your screen data or audio; it processes information locally and through secure AI endpoints only while you hold the activation key.
blocks.title: Compliance and data security

blocks.text: Financial planning involves sensitive data. You must ensure that your tools meet your firm's security standards. Lazur is designed to assist you, but it is not a replacement for your own due diligence. Always review any text generated by AI before sending it to a client.

blocks.text: Getting started with a better workflow

Start by auditing your own time. Track where you spend your hours for one week. You will likely find that you are spending far more time on admin than you thought. Once you identify the bottlenecks, use tools like Lazur to help you navigate them faster.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with my specific financial planning software?
faq.answer: Lazur works with any application on your Mac because it interacts with your screen, not the app's internal code. Whether you use RightCapital, eMoney, or a custom portal, Lazur can point at buttons or help you navigate menus.

faq.question: Is my client data safe when using Lazur?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur does not store your screen content or audio. It processes data only while you hold the activation key. It does not train AI models on your data.

faq.question: Can Lazur fill out forms for me?
faq.answer: Lazur does not click buttons or edit files for you. It can guide you through the process, point out where to click, or dictate text into fields, but you remain in control of the final submission.
